usedFor: Mailjet sends and tracks email, and Freshsales Classic updates the deal with “Update Deal” after “Email Link Clicked”.

bestTemplate.name: “Email Link Clicked” in Mailjet, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A click shows interest, so the deal can move stage or change its amount.

watchOut: A click in “Email Link Clicked” names no deal on its own, so “Update Deal” needs an ID or name.
